head.title: · MediaMatrix
head.b:skin: :root{--bg:#080a0d;--panel:#10141a;--text:#f5f5f4;--muted:#a1a1aa;--red:#e50914;--border:rgba(255,255,255,.09)}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;line-height:1.5}a{color:inherit}.mm-header{max-width:1400px;margin:auto;padding:22px 5%;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}.mm-brand{font-weight:900;font-size:22px;text-decoration:none;letter-spacing:-1px}.mm-brand span{color:var(--red)}.mm-shell{max-width:1400px;margin:auto;padding:0 5% 70px}.mm-hero{min-height:400px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;background:radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%,rgba(229,9,20,.16),transparent 45%)}.mm-eyebrow{color:#fca5a5;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.18em;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}.mm-hero h1{font-size:clamp(38px,6vw,70px);letter-spacing:-.055em;line-height:1.02;margin:14px 0;max-width:850px}.mm-hero p{color:var(--muted);max-width:680px}.mm-search{display:flex;gap:10px;max-width:650px;margin-top:24px}.mm-search input,.mm-select{min-height:48px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:#11151b;color:#fff;padding:0 16px;font:inherit}.mm-search input{flex:1;min-width:0}.mm-button{min-height:46px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;padding:0 20px;font-weight:750;cursor:pointer}.mm-toolbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin:20px 0}.mm-toolbar h2{font-size:25px;margin:0}.mm-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:26px 16px}.mm-card{border:0;background:none;color:inherit;padding:0;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;min-width:0}.mm-poster{aspect-ratio:2/3;width:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:14px;background:#171a20;border:1px solid var(--border)}.mm-card h3{font-size:14px;margin:10px 0 2px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.mm-card p{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin:0}.mm-status{padding:22px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--panel);border-radius:14px;color:var(--muted)}.mm-error{border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.35);color:#fecaca}.mm-detail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:240px 1fr;gap:34px;padding:34px 0}.mm-detail img{width:100%;border-radius:16px}.mm-detail h2{font-size:36px;margin:0 0 12px}.mm-overview{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8}.mm-providers{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:20px 0}.mm-provider{padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;text-decoration:none;font-size:13px}.mm-footer{padding:30px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.mm-hidden{display:none!important}.mm-widgets{margin-top:30px}@media(max-width:1100px){.mm-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}@media(max-width:650px){.mm-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:22px 12px}.mm-detail{grid-template-columns:1fr}.mm-detail img{max-width:220px}.mm-search{flex-direction:column}}a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px}

section.p: Explore real movie and series metadata through your separately deployed MediaMatrix application.

main.footer: This Blogger theme is a presentation client only. Accounts, PostgreSQL, playlists, authorized playback, and FFmpeg remain in the primary application. Availability varies by country and subscription.
